verification.verification_note: Official CEPS annual-report microsite identifies its 2023 institutional annual report; financial overview, project list, staff changes and publication highlights confirm publication identity and administrative content.

admission.reason: Tested A Route 1 (geopolitical R&I evidence), Route 2 (European R&I system trajectories), and Route 3 (research on European R&I-system mechanisms): this annual activity/accountability report lists CEPS programmes, outputs, members and finances. It does not itself supply a substantive analytical study of European R&I under any of those routes; links to separate studies do not convert the annual report into one.

results.reader_what: CEPS reviews its 2023 research projects, publications, staffing, events, finances and institutional priorities.
results.reader_more: The report documents activities by a European policy think tank, including EU-funded research projects. It is primarily an institutional retrospective and catalogue. Individual analytical CEPS publications could be eligible separately, but this report is not itself substantive European R&I evidence.

deep_analysis.main_finding: Describes CEPS operations, policy-research portfolio, annual highlights and organisational financing for 2023.
deep_analysis.method_or_basis: Institutional reporting, project and publication listings, activity counts and financial accounts.
deep_analysis.qualification: Annual activity reporting is not an independent analytical finding about Europe’s research and innovation system.
deep_analysis.radar_relevance: Indirect institutional context only; A Routes 1, 2 and 3 fail the substantive Europe/EU R&I evidence threshold.

results.reader_title: The Enemy Within: The Human Side of Governance, Innovation, and National Security in the Age of Data-Driven Big Tech
results.reader_what: A chapter examines the human dimensions of Big Tech, public governance, innovation and national security.
results.reader_more: The chapter discusses technology firms and state governance in a security context. The supplied material does not establish a substantive study of Europe’s research and innovation system. The scope test therefore does not support Strand A admission.

deep_analysis.main_finding: The chapter examines governance, Big Tech and national security through human and institutional dimensions.
deep_analysis.method_or_basis: Substantial matching chapter excerpt supplied with scanner work material; independent full-text retrieval not established.
deep_analysis.qualification: The chapter does not provide a substantiated Europe-specific research-and-innovation-system analysis.
